video_caption: The video begins with a young man with dark, slicked-back hair, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt and a dark necklace, standing against a plain white background. He gestures expressively with his hands while speaking, using various hand movements from pointing to clasping, and maintains an engaging, energetic expression with smiles and serious looks. At 0:21, the video transitions to a still image of Angelina Jolie. She has light brown hair pulled back, wears a black blazer and pearl earrings, and looks slightly to the side with a neutral expression, set against a blurred, dark background with an orange section. This transitions again at 0:26 to another still image of Angelina Jolie, this time with her light brown hair falling over her shoulders in soft waves. She is wearing a light, possibly white or silver, elegant gown with delicate straps and earrings, smiling gently at the camera. The background is dark, with partially visible colorful stylized text "BO" on the left and a "Disney" logo with "Queen" partially visible above it on the right, suggesting a movie-related event.

The video opens with a young man, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt, speaking directly to the camera against a plain white background. He is very animated, using various hand gestures, including pointing upwards with both index fingers while smiling, pointing downwards, making a chewing motion with his mouth while crossing his arms, and spreading his hands wide. He appears to be talking enthusiastically, with a mix of smiling and serious expressions. At 0:25, the scene transitions to a still image of a blonde woman with wavy hair, wearing an orange turtleneck, sitting next to a man with light brown, shaggy hair, wearing a blue collared shirt. Both are smiling and looking towards the right side of the frame, seated on what appears to be a sofa against a purple background. At 0:31, the video cuts to another still image of the same woman and man, now dressed formally and standing on a red carpet. The man is on the left, wearing a black suit, white shirt, and black patterned tie, smiling, while the woman, with shorter blonde hair, is on the right, wearing a light-colored, possibly sparkly, strapless dress, also smiling, with her left arm linked through his right arm. The background is blurred, showing buildings and parts of a red carpet event, with a sign in the distance that reads "THE BOSS."

The video segment opens with a vibrant orange advertisement for "hello bello," featuring a smiling man and woman sitting on a stylized rainbow-like structure amidst cartoon trees, a white skull, a flower, and a moon. Text on the left reads, "hello bello," "Meet Mom & Dad," and "Yep, we started a parenting company! We're here for you (just don't ask us to change diapers)." Below this is a button, "Start Bundling ->," and a link, "HELP ME CHOOSE." The scene then cuts to a man with dark hair, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt, speaking directly to the camera against a plain white background, using animated hand gestures and expressive facial movements. This transitions to a screenshot of a Google image search result showing a headshot of Jared Leto, a man with a beard, slicked-back dark hair, and blue eyes, wearing a black suit and red bow tie. The text below the image reads: "SYFY Jared Leto offered Valiant's Bloodshot role." The next shot displays a text article, with a highlighted sentence: "if I'm in Alaska and there's wild salmon out of the river, I'd probably eat it." Finally, the video cuts back to the man in the black t-shirt, continuing to speak animatedly and gesturing with both hands, appearing frustrated.

The video begins with a young man, seen from the chest up against a plain white background, wearing a black t-shirt. He has dark, slicked-back hair and is actively clapping his hands together and gesturing while speaking with an animated facial expression. The scene then transitions to a still image of Channing Tatum, in a dark suit, and Jenna Dewan, in a sparkling silver dress, seated at a formal event, both smiling at the camera with a blurred background of other attendees. This is followed by another still image of Jenna Dewan walking outdoors, wearing a light pink strapless dress, smiling directly at the camera with a blurred street background. The video then shows a still image of Meghan Markle, with long dark hair, wearing a light gray off-the-shoulder top, looking slightly to the side in an indoor setting with blurred shelves in the background. This transitions to a still image of Meghan Markle, in a light pink sleeveless dress, standing next to Prince Harry, who is in a dark suit jacket and white shirt, both smiling outdoors against a lush green background. The video concludes by returning to the young man in the black t-shirt against the white background, clapping his hands and gesturing animatedly as he continues to speak.

The video segment begins with a young man wearing a black V-neck t-shirt, standing against a plain white background, animatedly speaking and gesturing with both hands. He says, "Why you keep getting beat up and saying, 'Oh, I only try to get mugged during the week,' then on the weekends, I don't walk around the Bronx at 4 AM with a diamond necklace on." The scene then transitions to an image of a bald man with a beard and tattoos on his neck and arms, wearing a dark blue t-shirt, looking off to the right with a slight smile. This is followed by a screenshot of a blog post titled "Plant Chat: Bob Harper, The Biggest Loser," which features the same man (Bob Harper) and shows a "Recent Posts" list on the right, containing titles like "Real Pumpkin Spice Soy Latte (Vegan, Gluten-Free)" and "Smoky Chili with Sweet Potato (Vegan, Gluten-Free)." The video then cuts back to the young man, who continues to speak and gesture, explaining that Bob Harper practiced a vegan lifestyle but switched to a higher protein diet including egg whites, cheese, and fish after having a massive heart attack in 2017. He adds that Harper's vegan followers chastised him for eating fish, claiming it would lead to another heart attack, concluding with a sarcastic remark, "Aren't vegans such lovely people?"

A young man with dark, slicked-back hair, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt and a thin necklace, speaks animatedly against a plain white background, using dynamic hand gestures like pointing, spreading his hands, and bringing them together, with wide, expressive eyes and an open mouth. The scene then transitions to a man with short, dark hair and a wide, genuine smile, wearing a grey and white plaid shirt, looking to his left against a blurred blue and purple background. This is followed by a still image of the same man (Stevo) comically crammed inside a refrigerator overflowing with various fruits and vegetables like bell peppers, asparagus, broccoli, pineapple, and dragon fruit; he is wearing blue jeans, and his bare feet are visible, sporting a surprised expression. An English text overlay reads, "THE STEVE-O VEGAN RANT WILL MAKE YOU A BETTER ADVOCATE FOR ANIMALS". The video then cuts back to the first young man, who continues to speak with energetic hand movements and animated facial expressions, including rubbing his hands, gesturing with open palms, pointing, and shrugging, while maintaining an engaged look.

The video opens with a static medium close-up of rapper Waka Flocka Flame, a Black man with long dark dreadlocks and a short beard, wearing a black sleeveless top, several layered necklaces, and a prominent watch on his left wrist. His heavily tattooed arms are crossed, and he looks directly at the camera with a serious expression against a plain dark gray background. The scene then transitions to a young man with dark, slicked-back hair, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt, standing in front of a white wall. He actively gestures with his hands as he speaks, moving them to emphasize points, sometimes clenching them, and other times opening them wide, all while maintaining eye contact with the camera. The video concludes with a screenshot of a news article titled "Beyoncé and Jay-Z want their fans to go vegan" (English) dated "Jan 2, 2019 4:14 pm GMT." The article features a photograph of Beyoncé, with blonde hair and a patterned top, eating popcorn from a bucket, sitting next to Jay-Z, who is wearing a black top and pointing forward. A "Latest News" (English) sidebar is visible on the right, showing various headlines, including "The Big Read - Beabadoobee: 'I want to live in the 90s!'" (English).

The video segment opens with a screenshot of a web article from "Samantha Maine" dated "Jan 2, 2019 4:14 pm GMT," titled "Beyoncé and Jay-Z want their fans to go vegan." Below the headline, an image shows Beyoncé, in a patterned dress, eating popcorn from a red and white striped bucket, and Jay-Z, in a black shirt, pointing forward and looking intently. A sidebar on the right features "The Big Read - Beabadoobee: 'I want to live in the '90s!'" and "Latest News" headlines. A male narrator begins speaking about Beyoncé and Jay-Z issuing a "22-day vegan challenge" and encouraging fans to try their meal delivery service and buy their cookbook. The video then cuts to a young man with dark hair, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt, standing against a plain white background, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. He then transitions to a full-screen image of a book cover titled "THE GREENPRINT" by "MARCO BORGES," with a green leaf-like logo and the tagline "PLANT-BASED DIET / BEST BODY / BETTER WORLD." The video cuts back to the man, who states that Beyoncé and Jay-Z are not vegan and still eat meat. This is followed by a screenshot of another article titled "THE VEGAN DIET GIVES CHRIS HEMSWORTH HIS MARVEL-OUS MUSCLES," featuring a close-up photo of Chris Hemsworth with a beard and blue eyes, his hand resting on his head. The narrator returns to the screen, explaining that Chris Hemsworth, another actor who "wore the vegan title," was seen eating chicken and yogurt, before the man on screen widely gestures and shrugs with a sarcastic smile, implying that he too could pretend to be vegan while eating a "fat juicy steak."

The video segment opens with a screenshot of a news article headlined "Ellen DeGeneres Confirms 'I Am Not Vegan Anymore'". The sub-headline states, "The comedian and television star says she started eating pieces of fish 'for no real reason' a year or two ago - after eight years of veganism." Below this text, Ellen DeGeneres is seen on stage, holding a microphone, wearing a black long-sleeved top, against a dark background. This scene transitions to a medium shot of a man with dark, slicked-back hair, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt, standing against a plain white background. He gestures expressively with both hands while speaking, appearing to comment on Ellen DeGeneres's dietary choices, mentioning her eight years on the diet and now eating fish and eggs while still promoting veganism. The video then cuts to another news article screenshot, titled "Jennifer Lopez," showing Jennifer Lopez in the driver's seat of a car, smiling and looking towards the camera. The accompanying text reads, "J-Lo decided to go vegan in May 2014, telling a New York radio station that 'Being vegan, it's basically no dairy, no meat, everything is plant based and from the ground. Butter is the one thing I miss!'"

The video opens with a still image of Jennifer Lopez, smiling broadly and looking towards the right side of the frame, wearing a brown leather jacket and appearing to be in a car with a green background suggesting an outdoor setting. Overlaid text on the left reads "Jennifer Lopez" and below that, "J-Lo decided to go vegan in May 2014, telling a New York radio station that 'Being vegan, it's basically no dairy, no meat, everything is plant based and from the ground. Butter is the one thing I miss!'" Below this, "CREDIT: FILM STILLS" is visible. The top left corner shows "< 11 of 13 > View All" while the top right corner displays sharing icons and a section titled "FOLLOW THE TELEGRAPH" with social media links. The video then transitions to a young man with dark, slicked-back hair, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt and a thin necklace, standing against a plain white background. He is speaking directly to the camera, gesturing frequently with his hands, clenching and unclenching them, and using animated facial expressions to emphasize his points.

The video opens with two side-by-side still images of actor Samuel L. Jackson. On the left, he is depicted with a short, salt-and-pepper beard, wearing round glasses, and a light-colored collared shirt under what appears to be a cream-colored jacket. He looks slightly away from the camera with a subtle smirk. On the right, he is clean-shaven, wearing similar glasses, a striped blue and white button-down shirt, a white bow tie, and a dark suit jacket, looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. The background in both images is dark. At the 0:04 mark, the still images transition to a video of a young man with dark, slicked-back hair, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt. He stands against a plain white wall, actively gesturing with both hands as he speaks, maintaining a direct gaze at the camera, and displaying animated facial expressions, including a brief smile around the 0:11 mark.

The video segment begins with a medium shot of a woman with dark, slicked-back hair, wearing a black blazer with wide lapels. She stands with a slight smile, looking directly at the camera. Behind her, a dark background features the white text "NATIONAL LEAGUE HONORS" partially visible. The scene then transitions to a medium shot of a man with dark, slicked-back hair, wearing a black v-neck t-shirt. He stands against a plain white wall, actively gesturing with both hands and arms as he speaks, maintaining eye contact with the camera and displaying a range of dynamic facial expressions.

The video begins with a screenshot of a news article titled "Derek Hough Teases Holiday Special With Sister Julianne & 'World of Dance' Season 4," published on September 15, 2019. An image of Derek Hough, a man with styled blonde hair and a beard, wearing a dark suit jacket, is featured on the left, next to a sidebar displaying "FIND & REMIND," an ad for "THE DEUCE," and "WORLD OF DANCE" recent headlines, followed by "MOST POPULAR NEWS." At the 0:06 mark, the scene transitions to a young man with dark, slicked-back hair and a black V-neck t-shirt, standing against a plain white background. He makes various hand gestures as he speaks, including pointing at the camera, clasping his hands, gesturing with both hands, and extending his right hand to the side, before concluding the segment with his hands clasped and a serious expression.

The video segment opens with a close-up of actress Zooey Deschanel, who has long, dark, wavy hair with bangs, light blue eyes, and a serious expression, set against a solid blue background. This transitions to another close-up of Deschanel, now with slightly shorter, bob-length hair and small gold hoop earrings, smiling broadly against a white background with abstract blue and orange shapes. The scene then shifts to a young man with dark, slicked-back hair, dark eyebrows, and a black V-neck t-shirt, standing against a plain white wall. He is actively speaking and gesturing with his hands, sometimes clasping them together, sometimes spreading them wide, conveying an animated and engaged expression. The video concludes with a close-up of actress Laverne Cox, sporting a short, wavy blonde bob, dark eye makeup, light lipstick, and a glittering silver necklace, wearing a black strapless gown and looking upward with a confident smile, in front of a blurry dark background with partial text like "EMM" and "Television Academy" visible.

The video features a series of alternating clips between a male presenter and various female celebrities. The first celebrity, Laverne Cox, appears with blonde wavy hair, wearing a black strapless top and a sparkly necklace, smiling faintly against a dark background with partially visible white text "CREATIVE EMMY" and "Television Academy." The male presenter, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt, stands against a plain white background, speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. He is followed by Carrie Underwood, a woman with long blonde hair, looking forward with a neutral expression from a brown textured chair. The presenter returns, continuing to speak with animated gestures. Next, Anne Hathaway, with dark brown hair and a broad smile, is seen wearing a black turtleneck against a dark brown backdrop featuring the text "AVIRON PICTURES" and "SERENITY." The male presenter appears again, followed by Fleur East, a woman with large, blonde and brown curly hair, smiling brightly in a grey blazer against a plain light grey wall. The video concludes with the male presenter, still against the white background, continuing his dynamic presentation.

A young man with dark, slicked-back hair and a black V-neck t-shirt stands centered against a plain white wall, looking directly at the camera. He begins speaking with his hands clasped together, then extends his arms outwards with open palms, gesturing broadly, before bringing his hands back together in front of him. He then points both index fingers forward and then out to his sides, his facial expression remaining engaging and enthusiastic throughout this initial segment.
